explication: AutoRAG Agent is a self-evolving librarian for searching documents in place, verifying evidence, and returning curated findings; the repository also retains the legacy Python AutoRAG tool, which is not the main product mapped here. The documented workflow consults memory, searches through multiple retrieval methods, applies access controls and merges results, then directly reads promising sources and emits findings. The graph preserves the documented MinSync, Jikji, datasource, web, Lite, and feedback capabilities. Several subsystem links follow README descriptions because their implementation was not sampled.
